# 

![](reference/figures/logo.png)

Omics2Surv

Integrative survival analysis for multi-omics data

**Omics2Surv** is an R package for **survival analysis with
high-dimensional multi-omics data**.

It provides a unified and extensible framework to **fit, integrate, and
compare survival models**

across different omics layers under multiple integration paradigms.

## 📦 Package overview

**Omics2Surv** key features:

📥 Support for heterogeneous multi-omics data

🔗 Multiple data integration strategies:

``` R
Single-omics modeling

Early integration

Late integration

Joint integration
```

🍔 Standardized data handling via `MultiAssayExperiment`

📊 Unified performance evaluation

🔁 Fair and reproducible model comparison

📉 Classical, machine learning, and deep learning survival models

## 🔀 Analysis workflow

![](reference/figures/Workflow.png)

**Omics2Surv** follows a modular workflow: 1. Multi-omics and survival
input data 2. Data exploration 3. Variable screening and harmonization
4. Integration strategy selection 5. Survival model fitting 6. Marker
identification 7. Patient Assessment 8. Disease understanding

## 📉 Supported modeling strategies

### Single-omics, early and late integration

- **Cox LASSO / Elastic Net / Adaptive LASSO**  
  Penalized Cox models for high-dimensional omics data.

- **Penalized AFT models**  
  Accelerated Failure Time models with regularization.

### Joint integration models

- **CoopCox / AFTCoop**  
  Cooperative regression models that encourage agreement across omics
  layers.

- **blockForest**  
  Random Forests adapted for grouped multi-omics predictors.

- **flexynesis**  
  Deep learning–based survival models implemented via Python backend.

| Method | Reference |
|----|----|
| Cox LASSO / Elastic Net | [Noah Simon et al. (2011)](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v039.i05) |
| Cox Adaptive LASSO | [Hao Helen Zhang , Wenbin Lu (2007)](https://doi.org/10.1093/biomet/asm037) |
| Penalized AFT | [Piotr M. Suder, Aaron J. Molstad (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.9264) |
| CoopCox | [Georg Hahn et al. (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbae267) |
| AFTCoop | Angelini et al. (submitted) |
| blockForest | [Roman Hornung, Marvin N. Wright (2019)](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-019-2942-y) |
| flexynesis | [Bora Uyar et al. (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-63688-5) |

## ⚙️ Installation

You can install **Omics2Surv** from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("FraCalanca/Omics2Surv")
```

## 📚 Documentation

Function references are available on the package website.

## 🏛 Funding

This work is supported by the PRIN 2022 PNRR P2022BLN38 project,
Computational approaches for the integration of multi-omics data funded
by the European Union - Next Generation EU, CUP B53D23027810001.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`LinkedOmicsLikeData`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/LinkedOmicsLikeData.md)
  : LinkedOmics-like data format
- [`benchmark_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/benchmark_models.md)
  : Collect C-index metrics from a train/test MAE pair
- [`biological_screening()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/biological_screening.md)
  : Biological Feature Screening via a User-Supplied Gene List
- [`build_MAE()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/build_MAE.md)
  : Build a MultiAssayExperiment Object from SummarizedExperiment
  Objects
- [`c_heatmap()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/c_heatmap.md)
  : Build a C-index heatmap from a train/test MAE pair
- [`censoring_rate()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/censoring_rate.md)
  : Censoring Rate of a Survival Status Vector
- [`display_counts()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/display_counts.md)
  : Bar Chart of Category Counts for a Column
- [`early_integration()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/early_integration.md)
  : Early Integration of Multiple Omics Layers
- [`enrich_features()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/enrich_features.md)
  : Functional Enrichment of a Model's Features
- [`explore_pca()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/explore_pca.md)
  : Exploratory PCA and eigencorplot
- [`export_flexynesis_data()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/export_flexynesis_data.md)
  : Writes one cohort to disk in the directory structure flexynesis
  expects.
- [`import_flexynesis_importance()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/import_flexynesis_importance.md)
  : Import flexynesis feature-importance scores
- [`import_flexynesis_results()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/import_flexynesis_results.md)
  : Import flexynesis predictions
- [`late_integration()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/late_integration.md)
  : Late Integration of Multi-Omics Survival Predictions
- [`patient_stratification()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/patient_stratification.md)
  : Stratify Patients into Risk Groups from Training and Test MAEs
- [`plot_enrichment()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/plot_enrichment.md)
  : Dotplot of an Enrichment Result
- [`plot_heatmap()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/plot_heatmap.md)
  : Feature Heatmap Split by Risk Group
- [`plot_km()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/plot_km.md)
  : Kaplan-Meier Plot by Risk Group
- [`plot_umap()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/plot_umap.md)
  : UMAP of Patients Coloured by Risk Group
- [`predict_flexynesis_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/predict_flexynesis_models.md)
  : Predict from a trained flexynesis model on a new MAE
- [`predict_j_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/predict_j_models.md)
  : Predict from Trained Joint Multi-Omics Models
- [`predict_pen_reg_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/predict_pen_reg_models.md)
  : Predict from Trained Penalized Regression Models on a New MAE
- [`prepare_CNV()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/prepare_CNV.md)
  : Prepare Copy Number Variation Data as SummarizedExperiment
- [`prepare_RNA()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/prepare_RNA.md)
  : Prepare RNA Expression Data as SummarizedExperiment
- [`prepare_custom_data()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/prepare_custom_data.md)
  : Prepare Custom Data in LinkedOmics-like Format
- [`prepare_methyl()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/prepare_methyl.md)
  : Prepare Methylation Data as SummarizedExperiment
- [`prepare_test_SE()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/prepare_test_SE.md)
  : Prepare Test Omics Data as SummarizedExperiment
- [`retrieve_linkedomics_data()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/retrieve_linkedomics_data.md)
  : Retrieve LinkedOmics Data from TCGA
- [`run_Omics2Surv()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/run_Omics2Surv.md)
  : Run the complete multi-omics survival analysis pipeline
- [`run_flexynesis()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/run_flexynesis.md)
  : Run the flexynesis CLI (training mode)
- [`run_flexynesis_inference()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/run_flexynesis_inference.md)
  : Run the flexynesis CLI (inference mode)
- [`selected_features()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/selected_features.md)
  : Selected Features of a Penalised Model
- [`split_train_test()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/split_train_test.md)
  : Split Multi-Omics Data into Training and Test Sets
- [`supervised_screening()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/supervised_screening.md)
  : Supervised Feature Screening via Marginal Cox Model
- [`test_AFTCoop()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/test_AFTCoop.md)
  : Test AFT Cooperative Learning Model
- [`test_blockForest()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/test_blockForest.md)
  : Test Block Random Forest Model
- [`test_cooplearning()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/test_cooplearning.md)
  : Test Cooperative Learning Model
- [`test_cox_glmnet()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/test_cox_glmnet.md)
  : Evaluate Cox GLMNET Model on Test Data
- [`test_flexynesis()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/test_flexynesis.md)
  : Predict with a trained flexynesis model on the test cohort
- [`test_penAFT()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/test_penAFT.md)
  : Evaluate a Penalized AFT Model on Test Data
- [`top_features()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/top_features.md)
  : Top Features by Variable Importance
- [`train_AFTCoop()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_AFTCoop.md)
  : Train AFT Cooperative Learning Model
- [`train_blockForest()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_blockForest.md)
  : Train Block Random Forest for Multi-Omics Survival Analysis
- [`train_cooplearning()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_cooplearning.md)
  : Train Cooperative Learning Model for Multi-Omics Survival Analysis
- [`train_cox_glmnet_ElasticNet()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_cox_glmnet_ElasticNet.md)
  : Train a Cox Elastic Net Model with Alpha Optimization
- [`train_cox_glmnet_LASSO()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_cox_glmnet_LASSO.md)
  : Train a Cox LASSO Model with Cross-Validation
- [`train_cox_glmnet_adaptiveLASSO()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_cox_glmnet_adaptiveLASSO.md)
  : Train an Adaptive Cox LASSO Model
- [`train_flexynesis()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_flexynesis.md)
  : Train a flexynesis model on the training cohort only
- [`train_flexynesis_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_flexynesis_models.md)
  : Train a flexynesis model from a training MAE
- [`train_j_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_j_models.md)
  : Train Joint Multi-Omics Survival Models
- [`train_penAFT()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_penAFT.md)
  : Train a Penalized Accelerated Failure Time (AFT) Model
- [`train_pen_reg_models()`](https://fracalanca.github.io/Omics2Surv/reference/train_pen_reg_models.md)
  : Train Penalized Regression Survival Models on a MultiAssayExperiment
  Object
